summary.text: Mike Michna is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 134 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Ann Johnson.

paragraphs.text: Mike Michna won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 134, defeating Carolyn B. Bryant with 59.6 percent of the vote.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong public servant and former small business owner whose father was both a police chief and a preacher in the Church of Christ.
He listed service before politics, protecting freedom, families and the rule of law, and fiscal responsibility and local control as his key campaign messages.
